blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Dwight Ramos and Gilas Pilipinas are treating the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers as another “win or go home” situation. The Filipinos are currently at 4-4 in Group E, looking for a top-3 finish and an automatic qualification for next year’s World Cup in Qatar. “Pretty much every game in the second round is kinda like win or we’re out, so that’s kinda how we’re treating it,” said Ramos, who watched his girlfriend Kianna Dy play for PLDT against Choco Mucho in the PVL on Thursday at Mall of Asia Arena. “Four games left, we’re […]...
